title: قنديل | HR delivery sprints
release_goal: Deliver a reproducible, bilingual local Frappe HR release for P0–P3, with the selected 40 requirements verified against 80 baseline cases and targeted regression tests.
scope: P0 baseline + P1 security + P2 organization + P3 requests and vacancies. Full HR parity (P4–P10), company platform, Odoo integrations and production are separate milestones.
status_note: Development checkpoint: 45 passed, 27 partial and 8 blocked baseline cases; HR acceptance pending. Approved HR corrections, structural Return/code imports, session revocation, scoped export and AR/EN shortage display have new native/browser proof. The implementation goal remains active.

sprints.name: Reproducible project
sprints.outcome: A new machine can install the same pinned HR stack, and everyone can see the exact scope.
sprints.gate: Version lock + install/restore instructions + synthetic-site plan + requirement ownership reviewed; clean bootstrap proof required before setup is Done.
sprints.parallel: Lead: packaging. Security: interfaces. Organization: mapping. QA: baseline and cases.

sprints.name: Secure organization foundation
sprints.outcome: Position data and scoped authority are consistent, with safe write commands.
sprints.gate: Real accounts cannot cross company/branch boundaries; duplicate commands are safe; hierarchy, assignments and capacity constraints pass native tests.
sprints.parallel: Security and organization build independently against agreed scope/route contracts; lead fixes commands; QA prepares fixtures.

sprints.name: Complete hiring workflows
sprints.outcome: A request moves from draft through the correct approvals into an accurately tracked vacancy.
sprints.gate: Returns, amendments, delegations, CEO/board routes, capacity, priority and recruiter queues work under normal and negative cases.
sprints.parallel: Lead: request state machine. Security: identity/account controls. Organization: structural approval and capacity. QA: bilingual/native UI.

sprints.name: Integration and bilingual proof
sprints.outcome: The selected 40 requirements have dated evidence for all 80 baseline acceptance cases plus targeted regression cases.
sprints.gate: No unresolved critical authorization or headcount defect; concurrent operations reconcile; EN/AR native UI, files, exports and notifications pass; unresolved provider/policy cases stay blocked.
sprints.parallel: Security: adversarial tests. Organization: import/history tests. Lead: serial integration/concurrency. QA: EN/AR browser tests after fixture stability.

sprints.name: Reviewable release and handover
sprints.outcome: A tagged, reproducible local release, testing walkthrough and HR decision record.
sprints.gate: Independent source review, restore rehearsal, secret scan, tested commit pushed, evidence tied to commit, and HR UAT decision recorded. This is not production go-live.
sprints.parallel: Lead: release. Security: review. Organization: operator guide. QA: evidence pack and HR walkthrough.

parallel_policy: Four concurrent slots: Lead/integration, Security, Organization, QA/bilingual. Owners may change at sprint boundaries; no two agents edit the same file concurrently.
Freeze scope, route, command receipt and capacity contracts first. Independent source work can overlap sprints, but acceptance gates remain ordered.
Only Lead edits shared hooks/setup/schema integration, runs migrations, manages fixtures and creates release commits. Other workstreams return patches or file-scoped changes.
Use separate disposable sites for independent database suites when feasible. Tests sharing a database run serially, especially capacity races and fixture changes.
Baseline and translation work may run throughout. Browser acceptance starts after schema and fixtures are stable; security review is independent of implementation.
No unattended background work or recurring refresh is configured. Tracker changes when source/evidence are updated; user review marks are separate browser-local notes.
cadence: Outcome-based sprints, not promised dates. At sprint start confirm scope; during work update task evidence; at sprint close show the demo and gate. Estimate calendar dates after S0 clean bootstrap and initial fixture integration reveal actual blockers.
